name: hgi_sm_xl2_bdring

job.purpose: x-load cl2 leaf (H-SM 2026-10-15): the flat clock-leaf cl failed its --cts gate (multiple_cts_roots source on 32 SRAMs; bs_a 8,642 / md 5,635 / bq_v 4,125-load nets; bw->rq 21 levels). cl2 = cluster of hardened leaves (ctl, 4 x BF quarter of one master, 2 x the CLOSED tree13 quantiser tile, BD ring), one clock root each < 15k sinks, every leaf pin registered (owner 19:50), running issue-word registers (no multiply), replicated selects; +2 fixed edges on every xw beat (lock bench vs cl shifted 2).
job.structural_change: cl2i: pin density <= 6/um on every face (owner rule via H-ELEM audit 10-16). cl2f LEF measured E face 2,048 bq_d in 284.8 um (7.2/um avg, 10.05/um peak per 20 um), N 532 qq/qe in 53.3 um (10.0/um). cl2i: outline 99.36 x 369.36 with an explicit even pin plan (tools/ref_tile/spread_face_pins.py: N alternate M3/M5, W/E M4, clk W-centre): E 5.68/um, N 5.86/um, W 109 pins. RTL unchanged (main).
